setup_commonsense_qa_task: setup a CommonsenseQATask instance by loading the dictionary and configuring sentence ranking criterion
load_commonsense_qa_dataset: load a train, valid, or test split from a JSONL file into a Fairseq dataset
build_commonsense_qa_model: build a RoBERTa model with a sentence classification head for Commonsense QA finetuning
load_dictionary_with_mask: load a Fairseq dictionary from a file and add the mask symbol for RoBERTa
review_commonsense_qa_task: review the CommonsenseQATask class to understand how questions and choices are binarized and batched
